name: Charles French
bio: A legatee in George Ives's 1939 will, probably working-class and employed in the service sector - at the Spread Eagle Hotel, Midhurst, and latterly at 1 Greek Street, London W1 - whom Cook suggests was 'perhaps a former lover' of Ives.
bio_note: All from Cook, Queer Domesticities (2014), p. 110; Cook's endnote 84 credits the connection to Brian Lewis by personal communication, with no archival citation.
